mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained quarterly GDPC1 growth over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% triggers monetary tightening, increasing discount rates on corporate bonds and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward momentum in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and downward movement in unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust demand and labor market recovery, amplifying equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 ↑ and UNRATE ↓ occur.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPI inflation index below 2.0% in a late-cycle expansion regime reduces expectations of future rate hikes, lowering risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL drops below 2.0% in late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A peak in the INDPRO supply index followed by a downward crossing below its 50-day moving average signals potential supply-side constraints, tightening financial conditions and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses below 50-day MA.

mechanism_narrative: Conflicting trends in monetary policy (rising FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) create market uncertainty, tightening credit conditions and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS ↑ and CPIAUCSL ↑ in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS ↑ and CPIAUCSL ↑ occur in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) reduces labor market friction, boosting productivity and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE remains below 4.0% over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in HOUST demand indicator below 1400 units in a monetary tightening cycle tightens financial liquidity, increasing borrowing costs and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when HOUST drops below 1400 in the monetary tightening cycle.
